Q1_does_signal_predict_R2_C3.answer: PARTIALLY — post-VSS OP trajectory distinguishes R2-C1 (elevated OP) from R2-C3 (normal OP), but this is a KNOWN clinical variable (Hakim patent claims continuous pressure monitoring).

Q2_does_it_predict_earlier_than_routine.answer: NO — requires post-VSS LP, which clinicians already perform. The Hakim patent already claims continuous pressure monitoring with implantable sensors. No earlier signal has been identified.

Q3_does_acting_improve_decision.answer: UNKNOWN → possibly NEGATIVE. The proposed salvage treatment (CGRP mAb) has CONFLICTING evidence: 2022 study showed NO significant impact on persistent IIH headache; 2025 case series showed efficacy for 'chronic post-IIH headaches refractive to other preventive therapies.' The effect may be due to comorbid migraine, not IIH headache itself. No study has tested the full pathway: early R2-C3 identification → headache-directed treatment → improved outcome.

three_question_decision_value_test.verdict: A 'yes' to Q1 alone is NOT an invention. Q2 FAILS. Q3 is UNKNOWN/NEGATIVE. The candidate does NOT pass the three-question decision-value test.

candidate_kill_verdict.candidate: R2-C3 predictor (pre-treatment or early post-treatment physiological information → specific failure phenotype → salvage decision)
kill_rationale: 1. §103 SERIOUS THREAT: The Hakim self-adjusting-valve family (WO2020086847A1, US20210379344A1) already claims CSF pressure + venous pressure + differential + continuous monitoring (trajectory) + closed-loop valve control + IIH treatment. The proposed 'pressure trajectory → failure-type classifier' uses the SAME measurements for a different analytical purpose. Without a new technical effect, this is 'AI applied to an existing clinical variable.'

2. NO NEW TECHNICAL PRIMITIVE: No genuinely new signal has been found that predicts R2-C3 before routine clinical measurement would reveal it. All candidate discriminators are either: (a) known measurements already claimed by Hakim, (b) tested and found not significant (CGRP), or (c) untested with no available data.
3. Q2 FAILS (earlier-than-routine): The strongest discriminator (post-VSS OP trajectory) requires post-VSS LP, which clinicians already perform. No earlier signal has been identified.

4. Q3 UNKNOWN/NEGATIVE (decision improvement): The proposed salvage treatment (CGRP mAb) has CONFLICTING evidence. A 2022 study showed no significant impact on persistent IIH headache. The 2025 positive case series may be confounded by comorbid migraine. CGRP as a pre-treatment biomarker was tested and found not significant.

5. PER ARTICLE XXIX (mechanism failure): This is NOT an implementation failure (we couldn't build it). This is a MECHANISM failure: the underlying measurements are already known (Hakim), the proposed biomarker was tested and found not significant (CGRP), and the proposed salvage treatment has conflicting evidence (CGRP mAb). No new technical effect exists.
6. PER CEO DIRECTIVE: 'If no such primitive exists, kill the candidate.' No primitive exists. The candidate is killed.
what_this_does_NOT_mean: Does NOT mean R2-C3 is unimportant — the phenotype is real (3 confirmed per-patient cases in Ahmed 2011)
Does NOT mean no invention is possible in this space — a DIFFERENT approach (not pressure-trajectory-based) might work
Does NOT mean the zero-cost search was wasted — the search established the epistemic boundary honestly
Does NOT mean the ontology was wrong — the R2-C1/C2/C3/C4/C5 ontology is FROZEN and remains valid for future use

cemetery_record.kill_reason: §103 serious threat from Hakim self-adjusting-valve family + no new technical primitive + Q2 fails (no earlier-than-routine prediction) + Q3 unknown/negative (CGRP mAb conflicting evidence) + CGRP biomarker tested and found not significant
cemetery_record.lesson: The pressure-trajectory architecture was already claimed by the Hakim patent family for IIH treatment. Applying AI to classify the same measurements is 'AI applied to an existing clinical variable' — not a patentable invention without a new technical effect. The CGRP biomarker pathway was independently tested and found not significant, eliminating the most promising pre-treatment discriminator. Future approaches should seek a genuinely NEW signal source, not a new analysis of known signals.
